listings.title: GoldenTree ~ The Curious Victorian: A Collection of Rare & Remarkable Things ~ Burlington, NJ
listings.description: THIS AUCTION IS PICK UP IN BURLINGTON, NJ OR THIRD PARTY SHIPPING ONLY. NO 'IN-HOUSE' SHIPPING FOR THIS AUCTION. (Scroll to bottom for shipping and local delivery options) Step inside a truly distinctive Victorian estate filled with an eclectic mix of art, antiques, decorative objects, and unexpected treasures collected over a lifetime. This auction features an impressive variety of pottery and ceramics, original and vintage artwork, Art Deco sculptures, clocks, unique furniture, architectural and decorative pieces, collectibles, and one-of-a-kind finds that are anything but ordinary. From striking statement pieces to smaller objects with history and character, nearly every room holds something worth discovering. The collection blends periods, styles, and influences, making this a particularly exciting sale for collectors, decorators, dealers, and anyone drawn to unusual and beautifully made objects. Expect the unexpected — this is an estate where curiosity is rewarded. This auction is just the beginning of this truly incredible treasure trove, soon to be open to an in-person sale when we have made room for people to walk through. Help us speed up the process by bidding on these fantastic items to make room for more unpacking! ___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ PLEASE READ INSTRUCTIONS BELOW BEFORE BIDDING!! You will receive a confirmation/invoice for your winning bids, the day after the auction ends. Invoices over $1,000 will be required to pay via ACH or Wire at checkout. If you are not able to attend pick up and need to send someone else, please text the manager's number with your name and the person who will be picking up for you. They will need to show your invoice and sign the pick-up invoice. No shows and cancellations are not eligible for a refund. If you win auction items, you are responsible for getting them after the auction. There will be no refunds for inability to pick up items. listings.title: Thee Perfect Sale - 4 Days of a PACKED Historic Beverly Estate
listings.description: Thee Perfect Sale is headed to historic Beverly, New Jersey for a packed three-day estate sale inside a circa-1900 home filled with decades of collections, vintage finds, antiques, furniture, jewelry, clothing, glassware, collectibles, craft supplies and more. This is a true treasure-hunting sale with something in nearly every room, closet, cabinet, shelf and workspace — plus a full basement still being uncovered. The homeowners were both makers and collectors. She was a hat maker and milliner, and he was a fly fisherman and fishing lure maker , leaving behind specialized collections of millinery supplies, wooden hat forms, textiles, sewing and needlework materials, fly-fishing items, lure-making supplies and more. SALE HIGHLIGHTS INCLUDE: Vintage & costume jewelry Vintage clothing & accessories Vintage hats Millinery & hat-making supplies Wooden hat blocks / hat forms Fabric, trims, ribbons & notions Sewing supplies Embroidery & needlework supplies DMC embroidery floss Yarn & fiber arts supplies Patterns & craft books Doll-making supplies Vintage dolls & handmade dolls Fly-fishing equipment & accessories Fishing tackle Fishing lure-making supplies & components Handmade fishing-related items Antique furniture Vintage furniture Mid-Century Modern / MCM furniture & décor Asian-inspired furniture & decorative arts Multi-drawer apothecary-style cabinet Vintage bedroom furniture Lamps & lighting Artwork & wall décor Needlepoint & textile art Vintage baskets & woven pieces Pottery & ceramics Vintage glassware Green glass canisters & storage jars China & serving pieces Lenox Vintage kitchenware Cookware & bakeware Kitchen collectibles Linens & textiles Books & cookbooks Garden décor & statuary Home décor & decorative accessories Vintage collectibles Christmas decorations Halloween décor Seasonal & holiday décor PLUS an entire basement packed with more AND WE ARE STILL DIGGING. As we sort, organize and stage the home, we're continuing to uncover vintage clothing, collectibles, antiques, craft materials, furniture, glassware, kitchen items, holiday décor and unexpected finds. More photos and additional sale highlights will be added as setup continues, so check back before sale weekend. 🎃 HALLOWEEN WEEKEND ESTATE SALE We're having a little fun with this one. Costumes are encouraged all three days! Come dressed up, bring your estate-sale bestie and spend Halloween weekend treasure hunting through this packed historic Beverly home.

listings.title: Fixed 2 Move is in Elkins Park for this Special Sale
listings.description: Fixed 2 Move is pleased to present a fantastic estate sale in Elkins Park, Pennsylvania. This sale features a wonderful selection of mid-century modern furniture, vintage decor, framed artwork, and quality outdoor items. Highlighted pieces include two Harry Bertoia style Diamond chair in grey upholstery, a mid-century Art Deco style torchiere floor lamp, an antique Arts and Crafts style dark wood hall tree, and a country-style console table with a natural pine top and blue painted base. Fine decor items include an ornate damask runner rug, a roll of yellow chinoiserie wallpaper, and a framed vintage Victor Talking Machine Company advertisement featuring the iconic Nipper logo. Art enthusiasts will appreciate a curated selection of wine cork furniture, including a desk, chair, the drawer dresser and bench. The perfect addition to any party room or wine cellar. There is also wall art, including a signed mid-century modern harbor print, framed vintage panoramic equestrian prints, and a John James Audubon ferns illustration. for plant lovers and outdoor enthusiasts, the sale features a wide assortment of healthy, vibrant houseplants in decorative glazed ceramic planters, a wooden porch rocking chair, a mobile hose reel cart, and essential electric yard tools from brands like Ryobi and Black & Decker. We accept credit cards as well as Cash, Venmo and Cashapp on-site. Please join us for this diverse sale—reach out with any questions, and we look forward to seeing you in Elkins Park!

listings.description: Fixed 2 Move is pleased to present a varied estate sale in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania. This collection features a wonderful mix of fine traditional furniture, unique global decor, and artwork. Highlighted furnishings include a traditional dark wood secretary desk with a glass-front hutch, an antique tiger maple two-drawer stand, a dark cherry wood media console, a striped upholstered sofa, and a carved dark wood Asian altar cabinet with ornate pierced fretwork. Decorative accents range from a traditional Chinese carved wood folding room divider to vintage clear pressed glass double candelabras, a brass dragon-handled oil lamp, and a large Indian Kalaga zardozi embroidered wall hanging. Art lovers and collectors will appreciate a framed surrealist landscape oil painting in a gilt frame, an expressionist landscape depicting a gnarled tree, and hand-woven tribal kilim throw pillows paired with rustic terracotta urns.
